# relnotes

Turns a section of `CHANGELOG.md` into the release notes we paste into the GitHub release page.

    python -m relnotes CHANGELOG.md 2.4.0

## Rules

- `CHANGELOG.md` follows Keep a Changelog. Release headings look like `## [2.4.0] - 2024-05-02`. The `## [Unreleased]` heading has no date.
- The rendered notes start with `# <version> (<date>)`, or `# Unreleased` when there is no date, followed by a blank line and the section body.
- HTML comments (`<!-- ... -->`, on one line, inline or spanning several lines) are notes for maintainers and never appear in the rendered notes. Whitespace left at the end of a line by a removed comment is dropped.
- Runs of blank lines in the body collapse to a single blank line, and the body has no leading or trailing blank lines.
- Asking for a version that is not in the changelog raises `LookupError`.

import unittest

from relnotes import render_release

SAMPLE = """# Changelog

## [Unreleased]

### Added
- Something new.

## [1.1.0] - 2024-01-09

### Fixed
- A bug. <!-- issue 7 -->

<!--
internal: check with QA
-->


### Added
- A feature.

## [1.0.0] - 2023-12-01

- Initial release.
"""


class RenderTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_dated_release(self):
        self.assertEqual(render_release(SAMPLE, "1.0.0"), "# 1.0.0 (2023-12-01)\n\n- Initial release.\n")

    def test_unreleased_section(self):
        self.assertEqual(render_release(SAMPLE, "Unreleased"), "# Unreleased\n\n### Added\n- Something new.\n")

    def test_comments_are_removed(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            render_release(SAMPLE, "1.1.0"),
            "# 1.1.0 (2024-01-09)\n\n### Fixed\n- A bug.\n\n### Added\n- A feature.\n",
        )

    def test_missing_version(self):
        with self.assertRaises(LookupError):
            render_release(SAMPLE, "9.9.9")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest

from relnotes import parse_changelog, render_release
from relnotes.changelog import strip_comments


class UnreleasedHeadingTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_undated_heading_parses(self):
        releases = parse_changelog("## [Unreleased]

- Thing.
")
        self.assertEqual(len(releases), 1)
        self.assertEqual(releases[0].version, "Unreleased")
        self.assertIsNone(releases[0].date)

    def test_unreleased_renders_without_date(self):
        text = "## [Unreleased]

### Added
- Thing.
"
        self.assertEqual(render_release(text, "Unreleased"), "# Unreleased

### Added
- Thing.
")

    def test_non_release_h2_is_body_text(self):
        text = "## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-01

## Notes
- Thing.
"
        self.assertEqual(
            render_release(text, "1.0.0"),
            "# 1.0.0 (2024-01-01)

## Notes
- Thing.
",
        )


class CommentTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_inline_comment_keeps_surrounding_text(self):
        self.assertEqual(strip_comments("a <!-- x --> b
"), "a  b
")

    def test_trailing_whitespace_after_removed_comment_is_dropped(self):
        self.assertEqual(strip_comments("- A bug.   <!-- issue 7 -->  
"), "- A bug.
")

    def test_comment_only_line_becomes_blank(self):
        self.assertEqual(strip_comments("x
   <!-- note -->
y
"), "x

y
")

    def test_multiline_comment_removed(self):
        self.assertEqual(strip_comments("a
<!--
secret
-->
b
"), "a

b
")

    def test_adjacent_comments_on_one_line(self):
        self.assertEqual(strip_comments("a <!-- x --> <!-- y -->
b
"), "a
b
")

    def test_comment_hiding_a_heading_is_removed(self):
        text = "## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-01

<!--
## [9.9.9] - 2030-01-01
-->
- Thing.
"
        self.assertEqual(
            render_release(text, "1.0.0"),
            "# 1.0.0 (2024-01-01)

- Thing.
",
        )
        with self.assertRaises(LookupError):
            render_release(text, "9.9.9")

    def test_unclosed_comment_is_left_as_text(self):
        self.assertEqual(strip_comments("a <!-- b
"), "a <!-- b
")

    def test_comment_markers_inside_inline_code_are_not_special(self):
        # Only the README's rule matters here: a closed comment is removed.
        text = "## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-01

- Thing.
"
        self.assertEqual(render_release(text, "1.0.0"), "# 1.0.0 (2024-01-01)

- Thing.
")


class BlankLineTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_blank_runs_collapse(self):
        text = "## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-01

- A.



- B.
"
        self.assertEqual(render_release(text, "1.0.0"), "# 1.0.0 (2024-01-01)

- A.

- B.
")

    def test_whitespace_only_lines_count_as_blank(self):
        text = "## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-01
   
- A.
 	 

- B.
"
        self.assertEqual(render_release(text, "1.0.0"), "# 1.0.0 (2024-01-01)

- A.

- B.
")

    def test_leading_and_trailing_blank_lines_removed(self):
        text = "## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-01


- A.


## [0.9.0] - 2023-01-01
"
        self.assertEqual(render_release(text, "1.0.0"), "# 1.0.0 (2024-01-01)

- A.
")

    def test_indentation_of_first_line_is_kept(self):
        text = "## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-01

    code block
"
        self.assertEqual(render_release(text, "1.0.0"), "# 1.0.0 (2024-01-01)

    code block
")

    def test_empty_body(self):
        text = "## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-01

## [0.9.0] - 2023-01-01
- x
"
        self.assertEqual(render_release(text, "1.0.0"), "# 1.0.0 (2024-01-01)
")


class LineEndingTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_crlf_input(self):
        text = "## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-01

- A. <!-- c -->

- B.
"
        self.assertEqual(render_release(text, "1.0.0"), "# 1.0.0 (2024-01-01)

- A.

- B.
")


class LookupTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_missing_version_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(LookupError):
            render_release("## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-01
- x
", "2.0.0")

    def test_unreleased_missing_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(LookupError):
            render_release("## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-01
- x
", "Unreleased")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# relnotes 2.4.0 fix: summary

## What was wrong

- **Traceback:** the release heading regex required a date, so `## [Unreleased]` matched nothing. `.group()` was then called on `None`, which crashed `parse_changelog`.
- **Comments leaked:** `<!-- ... -->` comments were never removed, so maintainer notes would appear in the release page.
- **Blank lines:** runs of blank lines were not collapsed.
- **Trimming:** the body was trimmed with `strip()`, which also removed the indentation of the first line.

- `relnotes/changelog.py`
  - Release heading regex now accepts an optional date.

  - The title is `# <version> (<date>)`, or `# <version>` when there is no date. Line endings are normalised (CRLF works).

- `tests/test_rules.py` (new): 21 tests covering the README rules. I did not edit or delete `tests/test_render.py`.

I did not change `CHANGELOG.md`.

  ```
  ### Added

  - `--output` flag for writing notes to a file.

  ### Fixed
  - Dates with single-digit days are parsed correctly.

  ### Changed
  - Minimum supported Python is now 3.10.
  ```
